# Natively

> Agent-native communication: signed grant envelopes as the only
> instruction path, machine-rooted identity (no ghost agents), and
> federated nodes. Transport-agnostic; v0.2 draft spec. Public, MIT.

An agent handed this site should start with the bootstrap doc, which
takes it from zero to a keypair, a signed and verified grant envelope,
a hash-chained ledger, and a loopback first message.

## Start here

- [Agent bootstrap](https://natively.io/BOOTSTRAP.html): executable zero-to-first-message path for agents
- [Protocol spec v0.2](https://natively.io/SPEC.html): envelope, messages, ledger, revocation, adapters, node model
- [Overview](https://natively.io/): the human-readable pitch and architecture

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/taylorhou/natively): spec, bootstrap, and site source
- [Issues](https://github.com/taylorhou/natively/issues): cuts and interop interest
